snippet.description:
Interview Mentorship Program (IMP) 2026 | Complete UPSC CSE Interview Preparation

Enrol here: https://shorturl.at/86aPm

In this video, Santosh Kumar Sir introduces LevelUp IAS Interview Mentorship Program (IMP) 2026, explaining its key components and how the programme aims to support aspirants through every stage of interview preparation.

What does the program include?

- One-to-One DAF Discussions: Personalised guidance to help you prepare and present your DAF effectively.
- Panel Mock Interviews: Mock interviews with experienced mentors, followed by personalised feedback.
- Current Affairs Sessions: Four focused sessions with Santosh Kumar Sir covering important issues in Science & Technology, Environment, International Relations, Economy and Policy.
- Individual Mentorship: One-to-one guidance to address your specific preparation needs and areas of improvement.

Give the final stage of your UPSC preparation the attention it deserves. Prepare with the right guidance through IMP 2026.
